page.layout: Two columns of index entries on one printed page, parallel under the running head "INDEX.". The left column runs from "fluuius pro Euphrate" to "Gaba", with the letter G and the entries "Gad" and "Gaba" below it. The right column runs from "Gallim" to "gemitum", ending with the catchword "gene-" at the foot. Handwritten pointing marks stand in the left margin and beside "gehenna" in the right column.

l.i: Fratres sunt omnes, qui recipiunt euangelium 622
de Futuris, ut de præteritis loquuntur uates 229
gentiū excidia cur per prophetas Iudæis prædicta 150.154.157.183.208

page.notes: Handwritten pointing hands (manicules) in the left margin beside "Fœdera" and "futura", and beside "gehenna" in the right column; these are manuscript marks and are not transcribed. "iuunda[?]": the first letters of the second entry under "Fœdera" are cut off at the line end and are doubtful. "amplectentes[?]": the word breaks between the lines as "ample" / "stentes" and the reading is inferred from the split; the S/I form is doubtful. "uictu-ræ" and "fera-rum": hyphens are printed at the line ends and are kept. The page number and any signature are not printed on this scan. The underlined "gentiū uocatio" is kept as an entry; the underline is not transcribed.
